title: Actual system reduction and comparison evaluation coordinates
statement: Fix the model family $D$ of [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models] and the evaluation-law coordinates of [def-sp-field-shriek-system-finite-laws]. For every coefficient field $E$, scheme $T$, and $m\le n$, a quotient restriction coordinate identifies restriction along the actual ell-power sequence ring map of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] with restriction along the constant sheaf map induced by the quotient map $\mathcal O_E/\ell^{n+1}\to\mathcal O_E/\ell^{m+1}$ of [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces] (the tower transitions of [det-sp-tower-gluing]), with identity maps on every section. Define $r^N_{n,m}$ by transposing the actual SemilinearSections derivedTransition of $N$ under the finite scalar adjunction of [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor] after exact localization of this section-identity coordinate. For a compactification and coefficient inclusion define the source and target evaluation isomorphisms of the already constructed system comparison using exactly its EvaluationLaw scalar and compact-support coordinates and the finite compact support of [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison]. These are actual maps and normalization data, with no assertion of existence or of a transition law.
